title: Acted clear speech corpus
why_promising: Primary non-singing British-English production: one male native speaker produced 25 TIMIT sentences in five clear-speech/listener conditions. The public University of Edinburgh deposit explicitly states that the corpus is accompanied by automatic and hand-corrected phone-level transcription and exposes WAV, label, TextGrid, prompt, and segmentation-criteria files. This is directly relevant to manual segment boundaries, durations, style/task effects, and future acoustic extraction while avoiding third-party recordings.
open_question: Resolve exact file-level licence/redistribution terms beyond the repository's Depositor Agreement; then enumerate and ingest all hand-corrected TextGrids/labels, prompts, recording-condition metadata, and segmentation criteria. Keep automatic-only labels separate from the manually corrected layer and checksum all downloaded source files.
